description: This file 'loadinfo.h' contains declarations and macros related to locale-dependent catalog lookup functions in the GNU C Library. It includes function prototypes, macro definitions, and a struct for managing locale files, focusing on locale aliasing, name splitting, and file lookup mechanisms.

methods.name: _nl_normalize_codeset
methods.description: Normalizes locale codeset names to common variants.

methods.name: _nl_make_l10nflist
methods.description: Creates a list of locale-dependent message catalog files based on locale parameters.

methods.name: _nl_expand_alias
methods.description: Resolves locale alias names to real locale names.

methods.name: _nl_explode_name
methods.description: Splits a locale name into its constituent parts such as language, territory, codeset, etc.

methods.name: _nl_find_language
methods.description: Extracts the language part from a locale name.
